# Definitions.net

> > Comprehensive multilingual dictionary and reference platform providing definitions, translations, and linguistic resources across multiple languages and writing systems.

Definitions.net, operated by STANDS4 LTD, offers extensive dictionary entries for Chinese characters, idioms, and vocabulary with support for both Simplified and Traditional Chinese. The platform serves users across Chinese-speaking regions including mainland China (中国大陆), Singapore (新加坡), and Malaysia (马来西亚), providing detailed word definitions, translations, and language references.

## Key Topics

- Chinese language definitions
- Simplified Chinese (简体中文)
- Traditional Chinese characters
- Chinese idioms and phrases
- Dictionary entries
- Translation services
- Language reference
- Character compounds
- Word definitions
- Chinese-English translation
- Idiom definitions
- Vocabulary reference
- Character meanings
- STANDS4 LTD
- Cross-regional Chinese language support

## Chinese Character Definitions

- [简](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/简): Chinese character 简 definition with compounds and vocabulary reference

## Chinese Idioms and Phrases

- [稳稳当当](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/稳稳当当): Chinese idiom definition for 稳稳当当 with comprehensive translations
- [似而非](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/似而非): Chinese idiom 似而非 definition with synonyms and language reference

## Chinese Vocabulary Reference

- [米数](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/米数): Chinese dictionary entry for 米数 with definition and translation
- [粳粳](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/粳粳): Simplified Chinese definition for 粳粳 with meanings and translations
